svg.aria-label: Orders flow from VM1 through the orders topic to VM4, where Spark Job 1 enriches them; the metrics flow back through the order_metrics topic to VM1 for Spark Job 2. Both topics have two partitions replicated across the brokers on VM2 and VM3.
